outcome: Timing of transfer (age at transfer, post-menstrual age at transfer)
Transfer trajectory (level of unit transferred to)
cohort: The study included 294,229 inborn infants born between 28 0/7 and 34 6/7 weeks gestation, admitted to NICUs in the US Vermont Oxford Network from 2016 to 2021.
finding: Over 4% of very and moderate preterm infants are transferred, with the median age of transfer being later and reflecting the provision of risk-appropriate care rather than immediate post-birth needs.
followup_time: Up to 47 days (median age at transfer for 28-week infants)
